change: New cumulative per-lock-type view: waits, wait_time, fastpath_exceeded, stats_reset
New function backing pg_stat_lock
BUFFERPIN renamed to BUFFER; BufferPin renamed to BufferCleanup; BufferContent replaced by BufferShared, BufferShareExclusive and BufferExclusive
New per-table scores and do_vacuum/do_analyze/for_wraparound indicators
New started_by and mode columns
New started_by column
New separate logging threshold for autoanalyze; log_autovacuum_min_duration now applies only to vacuum
New GUCs for freeze, multixact freeze, vacuum, insert vacuum and analyze score weights
New recovery status view with replay LSNs, timeline, transaction time and pause state
New count of logical_decoding_work_mem overruns
New slotsync_skip_count and slotsync_last_skip statistics plus slotsync_skip_reason in pg_replication_slots
New count of updates ignored because of concurrent deletes when retain_dead_tuples is enabled
New separate sequence synchronization error counter
Renamed to sync_table_error_count
New connecting state
New full-page-image WAL byte counter
New wal_fpi_bytes value for an individual backend
Log full-page-image WAL bytes
New CommitDelay and WaitForWalWrite/Flush/Replay events
New progress view for REPACK, CLUSTER and VACUUM FULL
New full or incremental backup type
Added to table, index, sequence I/O, function and database-conflict statistics views
New relation, attribute and statistics-object OID columns
New range-type extended statistics
New dynamic shared memory registry allocation view
New multixact count, member storage and oldest multixact statistics
Per-process-type levels using type:level syntax
Now enabled by default
Remote postgres_fdw, dblink and replication messages use local log format
New CopyFromRead and CopyToWrite events
New per-node I/O statistics
Reports effective WAL level while logical decoding is enabled dynamically
New extension filesystem location column
Now returns sequence page LSN
